constraints: EVE must register a deployed GIS MCP server; the documentation site itself is not an MCP endpoint.
file_path is local to the GIS server: share storage or transfer through /storage/download before using another server.
No reflectance calibration is applied and the GeoTIFF writer does not copy scale/offset metadata: calibrate from source item metadata/baseline before radiometric analysis.
Cloud percentage only filters scenes: apply SCL per-pixel nodata/cloud/shadow/snow mask before spatial statistics/model fitting.
B05 and SCL share 20 m resolution; B03/B04/B08 are 10 m and must be aligned separately to the native B05 grid. Current stack writer rejects differing band shapes.
No item_id parameter exists; returned item_id must be checked to keep downloads from the same acquisition.
Search fallback can relax cloud and date constraints; verify actual scene datetime and cloud cover in returned properties.
Retain a projected metre CRS; geographic output grids cannot supply metre buffer distances directly.
integration_status: Source contract reviewed; no GIS MCP server installed, registered, or invoked through EVE during this review.
